coreFeatures.header: Start 'Vibe Coding' with Careti, the AI coding agent that grows with you.
coreFeatures.description: Start free with credits. 100% Cline & Claude Code compatible. Lower costs than Cline with improved editing & prompts. ZAI GLM-4.7 and 266+ LLMs. Tools: Nano Banana image generation, image analysis, web search, document reading (PDF/HWP). 7-language UI.

welcome.tooltipContent: I can develop software step-by-step by editing files, exploring projects, running commands, and using browsers. I can even extend my capabilities with MCP tools to assist beyond basic code completion.

cliBanner.title: Install the CLI to delegate subagents
cliBanner.description: Use the CLI to launch focused agents for large searches or research tasks. Commands differ by Careti/Cline mode.
